jobs.description:
**Primary City/State:**


Greeley, Colorado**Department Name:**

Case Mgmt\-Hosp**Work Shift:**

Day**Job Category:**


Clinical Care
The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Health, we’re excited about what the future holds for health care. That’s why we’re changing the industry to make the experience the best it can be. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you.


Join Our Compassionate Care Team as a **Case Manager Care Coordinator**! We're seeking a dedicated RN or Master Social Worker to make a meaningful impact in patients' lives by coordinating safe, seamless transitions from hospital to home. In this rewarding role, you'll work directly with patients and their families to identify needs and arrange essential post\-acute services including home health, durable medical equipment, and rehabilitation placements. Enjoy an excellent work\-life balance with a 4\-day work week while being supported by a collaborative, team\-oriented culture that values your expertise. We provide comprehensive 6\-week orientation with experienced preceptors who will guide you through our systems including Windows 11, Cerner, CareAware, and Microsoft Teams—no prior experience with these platforms required. If you're passionate about patient advocacy and want to be part of a supportive environment where you can truly make a difference in discharge planning, we'd love to hear from you!

**SCHEDULE:**

* Full Time/ 40 Hours
* Monday\-Friday
* 4 ten hour shifts
* 7:00am\- 5:30pm
* Every 3 weeks weekend rotation (Saturday \& Sunday)
* Holiday rotations are required in this role
* Enjoy a flat rate $3/hour weekend shift differential

**LOCATION:**

* Banner North Colorado Medical Center

Banner North Colorado Medical Center is a 378\-bed Level II trauma center and acute care facility with over 3000 employees. Our hospital offers an array of inpatient and outpatient services including medical, pediatric, obstetric, orthopedic, surgical, heart, cancer, and critical care. As a regional medical center, we provide community\-based and specialty services for a service area that includes southern Wyoming, western Nebraska, western Kansas, and northeastern Colorado. In order to provide the most compassionate and innovative care possible, we bring together state\-of\-the\-art technology and an exceptional team of health care professionals. The Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center is amongst Northern Colorado's leading cancer diagnosis and treatment facilities for the healthcare professional, our Greeley, Colorado location offers access to a wide variety of recreational activities in an inviting, close\-knit community.
POSITION SUMMARY  

This position provides comprehensive care coordination for patients as assigned. The intensity of care coordination provided is situational and appropriate based on patient need and payer requirements. This position is accountable for the clinical quality of Care Coordination services delivered by both them and others and identifies/resolves barriers which may hinder effective patient care. The goal is to empower the patient and the family to participate to the fullest of their abilities in the discharge planning process. This position provides developmentally appropriate care for the population that it serves which includes planning for the safe discharge, continuity of care, the ability to recognize and plan for the unique needs of all ages as well as the physically disabled, mentally ill, chronically ill and terminally ill patient.


CORE FUNCTIONS  

1\. Manages individual patients across the health care continuum to achieve the optimal clinical care, financial, operational, and satisfaction outcomes.  

  

2\. Acts in a leadership function with process improvement activities for populations of patients to achieve the optimal clinical, financial, operational, and satisfaction outcomes.  

  

3\. Acts in a leadership function to collaboratively develop and manage the interdisciplinary patient discharge plan. Effectively communicates the plan across the continuum of care.  

  

4\. Maintains knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid and other program benefits to assist patients with discharge planning and choices. Knowledge of community resources relevant to health care, end of life dynamics, substance abuse, abuse, neglect, and domestic violence.


5\. Establishes and promotes a collaborative relationship with physicians, payers, and other members of the health care team. Collects and communicates pertinent, timely information to payers and others to fulfill utilization and regulatory requirements.  

  

6\. Educates internal members of the health care team on case management and managed care concepts. Facilitates integration of concepts into daily practice.  

  

7\. May supervise other staff.  

  

8\. Has freedom to determine how to best accomplish functions within established procedures. Confers with supervisor on any unusual situations. Positions are entity based with no budgetary responsibility. Internal customers: Patients, families, all levels of nursing management and staff, medical staff, and all other members of the interdisciplinary health care team. External Customers: Physicians and their office staff, payers, community agencies, provider networks, and regulatory agencies.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

**RN:** Must possess knowledge of case management or utilization review as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor's degree in case management or health care. Requires current Registered Nurse (R.N.) license in state worked. Requires a Mas

**Social Worker:**


ter's Degree in Social Work. Requires a Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW) (equivalent\*) or Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or have a MSW with the requirement to become licensed within 6 months of hire date. An equivalent license applies to states that do not recognize an LMSW; therefore, the employee must possess a Master’s Degree and be a Licensed Social Worker.

jobs.description:
**About us**  
Recover Colorado is an addiction treatment and co\-occurring substance use disorder program with a mission to provide the highest level of patient\-centered, holistic addiction treatment. Recover is looking for a dynamic team player to join their company in their mission to provide compassionate addiction treatment.

Recover provides Residential, Partial Hospitalization, and Intensive Outpatient programming, licensed by the state of Colorado, and the offices are located in Westminster, Colorado.

Recover specializes in individual and group therapy, and client centered treatment planning. They treat both males and females eighteen years of age and older.

Recover's vision is to create a new approach to the treatment experience and to raise the standard of individualized behavioral healthcare.

**Therapist Job Description**  
\-Provide individual and group therapy sessions daily with clients to address substance use and mental health concerns and promote emotional well\-being  
\-Develop and implement treatment plans based on client's needs and goals  
\-Work closely with admissions, and provide case management and aftercare planning  
\-Provide group and individual counseling  
\- Assist with crisis intervention  
\-Collaborate with other healthcare professionals, such as psychiatrists, social workers, and utilization review to coordinate comprehensive care, and after\-care for clients  
\-Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client charting and records daily, in accordance with Medicaid requirements and legal and ethical guidelines  
\-Carry a caseload and assist with regular communication between clinical, family, aftercare planning.  
\-Participate in any required clinical supervision and professional development activities to enhance clinical skills

**Requirements:**  
\- Interns may apply  
\-Certified Addiction Specialist CAS, or Licensed Addiction Counselor (LAC)  
\- Experience working in a clinical setting providing therapy to individuals with substance abuse and mental health disorders  
\- A Knowledge of evidence\-based therapeutic modalities and interventions  
\- Organized, energetic, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish a trusting rapport with clients from diverse backgrounds  
\- Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
\-Knowledge of insurance requirements for documentation is a plus (Recover can train)  
\- Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to ethical standards of practice

Benefits:  
\- Comprehensive healthcare benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance  
\- Paid time off for vacation, sick leave, and holidays  
\- Professional development opportunities for continuing education and training  
\-Supervision may be available for those candidates pursuing licensure

If you are driven to help people suffering from the disease of addiction and mental health issues, and you want to save lives while creating healthier and happier families, please apply within. To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your qualifications and experience in the field of clinical therapy.

jobs.title: Remote LPN/LVN Care Coordinator – CCM/RPM (Compact Multistate License Required)
jobs.description:
**About ColigoMed**

ColigoMed is a U.S.\-based digital health company supporting remote care programs for patients with chronic medical conditions.

Our AI\-enabled care platform connects patients, medical providers, and payers to support at\-home and virtual care programs. Our proprietary AI engine, ColigoAssist, supports providers and care teams with real\-time clinical visibility, patient engagement, and chronic care management workflows. We are focused on helping patients live healthier, more independent lives by delivering consistent, high\-quality remote care.

**The Role**

**Schedule:** Full\-time, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week  
**Hours:** 8:00am to 5:00pm ET  
**Pay:** $22\.00–$25\.00/hour, depending on experience  
**Status:** 1099 contractor initially  
**Future pathway:** Strong performers may be considered for W\-2 employment after 3 months, subject to performance, productivity, compliance standards, and business needs.

ColigoMed is hiring experienced Remote LPN/LVN Care Coordinators to support Chronic Care Management and Remote Patient Monitoring programs across the United States. This role requires:

* An active compact multistate LPN/LVN license
* Direct CCM/RPM or remote chronic care management experience
* Chronic disease management experience
* Prior remote healthcare work experience
* Strong documentation and patient communication skills
* Prior experience managing an assigned patient panel or active caseload in a structured remote care environment
* Successful management of an active remote care caseload of approximately 150\+ patients is strongly preferred

This is a patient\-facing remote nursing role. You will manage an assigned panel of patients, conduct regular outbound patient calls, document care activity accurately, support care plans, and escalate clinical concerns when needed. This role is best suited to nurses who enjoy structured remote workflows, ongoing patient relationships, chronic disease management, and consistent patient engagement.

**Why This Role May Be a Strong Fit**

* Remote nursing role
* Monday to Friday schedule
* No bedside shifts
* Ongoing patient relationships
* Structured CCM/RPM workflows
* Supportive clinical operations team
* Structured onboarding and workflow training provided
* Opportunity to be part of a growing digital health company

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Remote LPN/LVN Chronic Care Coordinator, you will:

* Manage an assigned panel of CCM/RPM patients, including regular outbound calls, follow\-ups, care plan support, and patient education.
* Support patient onboarding, program explanation, consent documentation, RPM setup, and ongoing program participation for Medicare and Medicare Advantage patients.
* Review patient needs, symptoms, medication adherence, care plan progress, barriers to care, and RPM/device issues in accordance with approved workflows.
* Document all patient interactions accurately and on time, including call content, duration, follow\-up needs, care plan updates, barriers to care, and escalation actions where applicable.
* Accurately record actual patient engagement, care coordination activity, follow\-up work, and billable\-support time in accordance with ColigoMed workflows and CCM/RPM documentation requirements.
* Complete assigned patient follow\-up tasks promptly and ensure unresolved patient needs, symptoms, medication concerns, device issues, or escalation items are followed through to completion.
* Escalate clinical concerns appropriately and promptly to providers and/or the Clinical Operations team.
* Maintain care plans in coordination with providers and the Clinical Operations team.
* Meet expected productivity, quality, documentation, compliance, follow\-up, and patient engagement standards.
* Participate in QA review, internal audit feedback, coaching, and process improvement when documentation, follow\-up, timekeeping, or workflow issues are identified.

**Productivity and Quality Expectations**  
This is a structured remote care role with clear expectations for patient engagement, documentation, quality, compliance, and productivity. Successful nurses will be expected to manage regular patient outreach, maintain accurate same\-day documentation, follow standardized CCM/RPM workflows, and meet agreed performance expectations once fully trained and when patient volume supports this level.

Productivity credit must be supported by accurate documentation, appropriate time records, completed patient follow\-up, and compliance with approved workflows. We assess performance across patient engagement, care continuity, documentation quality, compliance, follow\-up completion, call quality, escalation judgment, and productivity. We do not assess performance on volume alone. Quality, compliance, and patient care standards are essential.

**Required Qualifications and Experience** 

Candidates must have:

* Active LPN/LVN compact multistate license.
* Minimum 6–10 years of nursing experience, including chronic disease management.
* At least 2 years of direct experience working in a structured remote CCM, RPM, chronic care management, telehealth, or virtual care company.
* Prior experience working in a structured remote care company, CCM/RPM provider, telehealth company, population health organization, or similar service model where nurses use a digital care\-management platform to manage assigned patient panels, conduct scheduled outreach, document interactions, update care plans, and support billing/compliance workflows.
* Demonstrated experience using a remote care platform, EMR, telehealth system, RPM dashboard, or digital care\-management tool as part of daily clinical workflow.
* Experience managing an assigned panel of patients in a remote or virtual care environment, including regular outbound patient calls, follow\-up tracking, care plan updates, and escalation of clinical concerns.

jobs.title: Finance Program Coordinator — AI Training Data Operations
jobs.description:
Finance Program Coordinator — AI Training Data Operations is a remote review track for evaluating AI outputs across finance and risk workflows. Reviewers grade calculations, narrative reasoning, and policy adherence; flag compliance and reconciliation issues; and document the correct treatment so the modeling team can train on it.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------


Finance and risk workflows leave no room for fuzzy reasoning. AuraOne uses experienced finance\-and\-risk professionals to grade AI outputs the way an audit reviewer would — with citations, severity tags, and the corrected calculation alongside the original.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current finance and risk standards, regulations, and firm policy for Finance Program Coordinator — AI Training Data Operations assignments.
* Re\-perform calculations and flag rounding, classification, or treatment errors.
* Tag compliance, reconciliation, and disclosure issues with structured severity scores.
* Capture the corrected workpaper or narrative so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published standards or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer\-quality scores in inter\-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Direct working experience with finance and risk on real engagements, transactions, or audits for Finance Program Coordinator — AI Training Data Operations work.
* CPA, CFA, ACA, or comparable credential — or equivalent applied experience.
* Comfort applying multi\-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that cites standards, regulations, or firm policy.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Re\-perform a finance and risk calculation produced by a model and flag any rounding or classification errors.
* Grade a model's narrative reasoning on a complex transaction and rate the citation quality.
* Adjudicate a disputed treatment between two reviewers using current standards.
* Audit a 25\-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Big Four, bulge\-bracket, or in\-house controller / risk experience.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted close, audit, or risk tooling and its failure modes.
* Bilingual experience for cross\-jurisdiction reviews.

**Skills**
----------

* Financial analysis
* Audit\-grade review
* Regulatory standards
* Risk assessment
* Finance and risk

**Work model**
--------------


Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.

**Compensation**
----------------


$40–$60 / hr

**Application process**
-----------------------


Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.
